_readme: Spoken narration for the homepage app, in Doug Devitre's ElevenLabs voice.
The words come from repos.json, journey.json, journey.<lang>.json and i18n/<lang>.json (see .github/scripts/narration-clips.sh); this file holds only how they are performed.
Voice settings match Distributed Virtue Season One (profile warm-v2) so both sites sound like the same person.

One voice for every language: eleven_multilingual_v2 detects the language from the text. The API's language_code hint is not supported for multilingual_v2 models, so none is sent; Spanish clips (ids ending -es) are spoken from the Spanish text alone.
The voice id is not a secret. The API key is: it lives only in the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY repository secret.
